senses.gloss:
अध्रि अ-ध्रि, इस्, इस्, इ (rt. धृ), unrestrained,
irresistible.
—अध्रि-गु, उस्, plur. आवस्, m., Ved.
irresistible; N. of a heavenly killer of victims; N. of
a formula concluding with an invocation of Agni.
—अध्रि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. irresistible.
—अध्रि-
पुष्पलिका, f. a species of the Pāṇ plant, Piper Betel.

अ-ध्रियमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (pres. pass. part. of rt.
धृ with अ), not held; not to be got hold of, not
forthcoming, not surviving or existing, dead.

अध्रुव अ-ध्रुव, अस्, आ, अम्, not fixed, not
permanent; uncertain, doubtful; separable, admitting
of severance without disastrous effects.

अध्रुष अध्रुष, अस्, m. quinsy, a kind of
sore throat (etymology doubtful).

आध्र आध्र, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ध्रै?), Ved.
poor, destitute, indigent, weak.
